state_parent_names.name: sqlite::native_custody_tests::guarded_pool_retains_custody_when_native_open_is_cancelled
state_parent_names.mechanism: Owned ordinary libtest subprocess holds a real File lock. sqlite3_auto_extension blocks during native open; the real state opening future is actively polled to the callback then cancelled. Parent independently opens/try_locks in another process while child gate is still zero; after release and actual resource destruction, lock succeeds.
state_parent_names.expected: WouldBlock before native gate release; gate_status=0 is checked after physical probe. After native close: lock available and gate_status=1; child exits successfully and is reaped.

state_parent_names.name: sqlite::native_custody_tests::coordinated_pool_retains_custody_when_initial_pragma_is_cancelled
state_parent_names.mechanism: Same physical cross-process proof, with a real SQLite progress callback paused during initial statement execution. The actual coordinated state constructor is used. Its before_checkout is a deliberate panic sentinel because it must not be reached before cancelled initialization finishes; it is not a successful no-op coordinator.
state_parent_names.expected: Same physical lock/gate proof. Any successful early open, checkout sentinel, callback timeout or cleanup failure does not qualify.

test_review.actual_mechanism: Ordinary libtest child, actual private File lock, real sqlite3_auto_extension/progress callbacks, opening future actively polled with tokio::select until callback entry, then cancelled. Independent parent process opens and probes the real lock.
test_review.callback_bound: Five seconds. After the physical probe the parent must receive gate_status=0; timeout/disconnect status2 or setup/selector failure cannot count as missing-custody causal evidence.
test_review.cancellation_precision: The current-thread Tokio runtime is a temporary and is dropped immediately before drop(opening). These controls cover cancellation with runtime shutdown; they do not separately prove runtime-alive cancellation. The native worker is the original SQLx thread. No unbounded Tokio task is introduced.
test_review.release_precision: ResourceOwner::drop closes its File before sending the release event; the parent then observes native_closed, gate_status=1 and real lock availability. The dependency's close ordering remains a separate required gate.
test_review.cleanup: OwnedScenario drops its stdin and receiver, kills/waits an unreaped direct child and joins the bounded stdout reader. Successful child exit is reaped and checked. No grandchild or shared host process is involved.
test_review.support_count: Two selected state parents plus one selected Memory parent. The explicitly ignored child support is invoked by exact name and is not a fourth PASS; no test has been run.
test_review.memory_mechanism: Actual CognitiveStore and detached native connection: live SELECT and original exclusive OpenGuard contention before and after removal of commit hook plus replacement of reserved collation; no writes after oracle removal. Physical close must release custody. This control uses independent handles in one process, not cross-process qualification.

causal_requirements: Both owned state children must actually enter the intended native callback, the opening future must be cancelled, and parent must observe an erroneously available real lock while post-probe gate_status remains zero.

The Memory test must complete original opening/close/live-SELECT/initial contention and emit both_registered_anchors_removed=true native_close_started=false; only then unexpected exclusive-lock success proves missing native custody.
Compile/setup errors, no tests, a failed child selector, gate timeout/outcome 2, sentinel panic, earlier SQL failure or missing stage do not count as causal negatives.
counterfactual_review.actual_results: NONE: setup, compile, physical controls and negative failures have not run.

open_concrete_gap.finding: After closing the guarded validation pool, actual Memory recovery opens a separate ordinary single connection for wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE) and journal_mode=DELETE. Its options do not carry the proposed native token. The caller's lexical exclusive guard does not by itself establish native lifetime through future cancellation.
open_concrete_gap.severity_scope: Existing separate entry remains open; not introduced by these four lines. The manifest's description of two guarded recovery pool calls is accurate, but must not be generalized to the whole recovery flow.
open_concrete_gap.next_action: Parent authorized separate read-only full caller/test/ownership audit and a distinct minimal proposal on 27b123 if the cancellation gap is confirmed. Do not modify this frozen binding cohort.
